source_title: Pick of the stats: Stoke City v Preston North End - BBC
source_excerpt:
Stoke City will seek to jump back into the automatic promotion places, for a few hours at least, as they welcome Championship basement boys Preston North End on Saturday (12:30 GMT).
Mark Robins' men had taken 12 points from five games before being held to a goalless draw at home to Bristol City on Saturday to drop to ninth, but the Potters have struggled against North End in recent years.
The Lilywhites are winless in seven but did pick up their first point in four games under Graham Alexander with a 1-1 home draw against West Bromwich Albion last time out. However, they have taken just one point from six games on the road this season.
Stoke City have won just one of their past seven league games against Preston North End (D3 L3), failing to score in four of those matches.
